LanguageData.Dominion_WarGoal_Punitive_Desc: Teach them a lesson. If you win, their stability, legitimacy and economy suffer.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarGoal_Conquest_Desc: Take a settlement. If you win, it is ceded to the winner (to you as a vassal outpost through Faction Territories), or they pay instead.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarGoal_Vassalisation_Desc: Make them a puppet: it obeys, pays a little tribute, never attacks you and joins your wars.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarGoal_Tribute_Desc: They pay a large sum at the peace and tribute for 180 days after.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarGoal_RegimeChange_Desc: Overthrow their government. The new regime owes its position to the winner.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarGoal_Liberation_Desc: Free the settlements they have taken from others and return them to their owners.
LanguageData.Dominion_War_JoinedPeaceText: The war you were part of has ended. {0} offers you peace as well.
LanguageData.Dominion_War_SurrenderOfferText: {0} can fight no longer and offers to surrender. The terms would be:\n\n{1}
LanguageData.Dominion_War_CallToArmsText: Your ally {0} is at war with {1} and asks you to join. Refusing will disappoint them.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_WhitePeace: Neither side has the upper hand: a white peace, with no terms.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_Victory: {0} has the upper hand and sets the terms for {1}:
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_ConquestPaid: {0} has no settlement to give up and pays instead.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_CedeFailed: The cession could not be carried out, so {0} pays instead.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_PlayerTributary: You must pay tribute to {0} for 180 days.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_Tribute: {0} pays {1} now, and tribute for 180 days.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_PlayerHumbled: {0} humiliates your government: you lose 30 influence.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_RegimeChange: The government of {0} is overthrown and replaced.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_Punitive: {0} pays the price of defeat in stability, prestige and wealth.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_PaidToPlayer: {0} pays you {1} silver, delivered by drop pod.
LanguageData.Dominion_Terms_Paid: {0} pays {1} a share of its wealth.
LanguageData.Dominion_Treaty_Imposed: Imposed by a peace or a coup; it cannot be proposed.
LanguageData.Dominion_Tribute_PaidByPlayer: You paid {0} silver in tribute to {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Tribute_DefaultText: You could not pay the {1} silver you owe {0}. The tribute treaty is broken, and every faction will hear of it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Blockade_NoFighters: needs a colonist able to fight
LanguageData.Dominion_Blockade_Started: Your caravan is blockading {0}. Each day its economy suffers and the war tilts your way. Keep the caravan there to keep it up.
LanguageData.Dominion_Blockade_Lifted: The blockade of {0} has been lifted.
LanguageData.Dominion_Blockade_SortieText: The garrison of {0} has sallied out to break your blockade. Fighters of {1} are attacking your caravan!
LanguageData.Dominion_Warband_InterceptActOfWar: Intercept the warband of {0} (an act of war)
LanguageData.Dominion_Warband_InterceptedText: Your caravan has fallen on a warband of {0}. Every one of them you defeat counts in the war.
LanguageData.Dominion_Warband_ApproachingText: A warband of {0} is marching on your colony and will arrive in about {1}. A caravan can try to intercept it on the way.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarTab_NoBlockades: None. A caravan at an enemy settlement can blockade it.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarTab_Details: Under way for {0}. Battles: {1}. Settlements occupied: {2}.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarTab_PeaceNow: Peace now would mean... (hover for the terms)
LanguageData.Dominion_WarTab_Score_Desc: War score, from {1} winning (left, blue) to {0} winning (right, red). It moves with battles, occupations, blockades, deaths in combat, and slowly with the balance of strength and war weariness. 25 or more ahead sets the terms of a peace; far enough ahead, the loser capitulates.
LanguageData.Dominion_WarTab_NoWarbands: None in sight. You see the warbands of factions you have intel 25 or more on, and any near your colonies or caravans.
LanguageData.Dominion_CallToArms_NoWar: None of your enemies is one {0} could fight.
LanguageData.Dominion_CallToArms_Refused: {0} will not join your war against {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_ColdWar_Disabled: Cold wars are switched off in the settings.
LanguageData.Dominion_ColdWar_Confirm: Declare a cold war on {0}? They will resent it, their spies will be busier in your colony, and their enemies will like you better. It is not war, but it can become one.
LanguageData.Dominion_ColdWar_Ended: The cold war with {0} is over.
LanguageData.Dominion_ColdWar_EndRefused: {0} refuses to end the cold war.
LanguageData.Dominion_Proxy_NoTarget: {0} is not at war with anyone you oppose.
LanguageData.Dominion_Proxy_Done: Your silver and weapons reach {0} for its war against {1}.
LanguageData.Dominion_Proxy_Leaked: Your aid to {0} has leaked: {1} knows you are behind it.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_ModeBoth: Run it off-map from here, or in person: send a caravan with your agents to one of their settlements and choose the operation there, for a bigger reward.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_ModePhysical: In person only: form a caravan with your agents and choose this operation at one of their settlements.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalOnly: This operation can only be run in person, from a caravan.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_NeedsNetwork: Needs a network of at least {0} there.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_NotWhileHostile: Not against a faction you are at war with.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_TooStable: {0} is too stable for a coup (needs stability {1} or less).
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalBusy: Another operation is already under way in person.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalReport: heading to {0} on a covert operation
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalBrief_KillLeader: Your agents are inside {1}. The target, {2}, is marked. Kill them, then get your people out.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalBrief_DestroyBuildi: Your agents are inside {1}. Destroy the marked {2}, then get out.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalBrief_ReachTarget: Your agents are inside {1}. Reach the marked {2}, then get out.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalBrief_RescueHostage: Your agents are inside {1}. {2} is held prisoner here: reach them and bring them home.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalStealth: The guards of {0} are not hostile, for now. Every hour your agents stay, they may be noticed, and then it is war. The operation ends when your agents leave the map.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalHostile: {0} is at war with you: expect a fight. The operation ends when your agents leave the map.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalDone_KillLeader: The target is dead. Get out!
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalDone_ReachTarget: Your agents have what they came for. Get out!
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_PhysicalDone_RescueHostage: The captive is free. Get everyone out!
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_AlarmText: Your agents have been discovered in {1}! {0} is now hostile, and its guards are coming for them. Get out.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_SabotageText: Foreign saboteurs have struck the colony: the {0} has broken down.
LanguageData.Dominion_Ops_RunOnVisit_Desc: Your colonists visiting this settlement (Visit Settlements) carry out the operation in person, where they stand. The operation ends when they leave the map.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_AiCovertOps_Desc: AI intelligence services also sabotage, incite riots, stage false flags, coups and assassinations, against each other and against you.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_PhysicalDetection: Detection in operations run in person: {0}
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_PhysicalDetection_Desc: How quickly guards notice your agents on their map.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_Warbands_Desc: Factions at war send armies across the world map to besiege, blockade and raid, and to reinforce their allies.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_WarbandRaids_Desc: Factions at war with you may march warbands on your colony. They arrive as raids sized like any other. When off, warbands only fight each other.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_Occupation_Desc: Victorious warbands occupy enemy settlements. The peace decides whether they are kept.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_CapitulationScore_Desc: When one side of a war is this far ahead, the loser surrenders on the winner's terms. When you are involved, you are asked.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_JointWars_Desc: Factions at war ask their allies and puppets to join, you included.
LanguageData.Dominion_Setting_ColdWars_Desc: Bitter rivals of similar strength enter cold wars: arms races, propaganda, border skirmishes and proxy wars.
